Name: Joe Bomb
Description: Until Zeitgeist discovered him, Joe Bomb had used his powers to blow up the neighbor's cats. Zeitgeist tought him to think bigger and he became a member of the X-Cellent. In his fight against X-Statix, his explosive powers blew up in his face when it was blocked by Rosa Lemper.
